besluite.fout: 'deel wees van' follows English word order
besluite.rede: Afrikaans places the complement before the verb ('deel van 'n groep wees'); meaning unchanged.
'uitgelaat word' is the clearer verb for being excluded, and the context fixes the sense.

besluite.fout: 'kom in gewone oomblikke' lacks the particle of 'voorkom' and reads wooden
besluite.rede: Adding 'voor' gives the natural verb for 'occurs' without moving the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'hou sy huiswerk uit' can read as 'uithou' (endure)
besluite.rede: 'na jou toe uit' makes the offering gesture unambiguous; the friend is already offering it to 'jou' in the same sentence.

besluite.fout: compound verb 'saamlag' split in a subordinate clause
besluite.rede: AWS writes 'saam' compounds as one word in the dat-clause.
'lyk nie na veel nie' is established idiomatic Afrikaans, and 'onbelangrik' narrows 'seems minor/harmless' to 'unimportant'.

besluite.fout: 'deur 'n foon' is a loose rendering of 'through a phone'
besluite.rede: 'oor die foon' is the fixed Afrikaans expression and keeps the same means of pressure.

besluite.fout: 'en sê' can be misread as part of the relative clause about the photo
besluite.rede: Splitting makes the group the clear speaker; 'Hulle' matches the earlier 'n Groep ... Hulle' pattern.

besluite.fout: 'en stap weg' after a dat-clause can read as part of what you say
besluite.rede: A new main clause with its own subject and the AWS comma makes walking away the action, which is what the original word order already meant.
The original is clear and short; the proposal is longer and itself calques 'when it comes to', in a safety-adjacent sentence best left as checked.

besluite.fout: bare 'Nee sê' as subject is colloquial for written text
besluite.rede: The om-te construction is the natural written form and matches 'Om nee te sê' earlier in the lesson.

besluite.fout: the definition opens with 'Wanneer' (an 'is when' pattern) for a noun
besluite.rede: This rewords a glossary definition that may be shared across lessons, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once.
